name: Copper
notes: API token + user email in headers; OAuth2 for partner integrations. No free plan; "API & Embedded integration SDK" on Professional tier and above; free trial available. Only third-party MCP servers found.

name: Plain
notes: Machine-user API keys sent as Bearer; no free plan, 7-day free trial then from $35/seat; official MCP at mcp.plain.com/mcp

name: Discord
notes: Bot token or OAuth2 bearer token; free developer portal; REST + Gateway websocket; only community MCP servers

name: LinkedIn Ads
notes: OAuth 2.0; Advertising API requires an application review before Development tier access; no official LinkedIn Ads MCP as of Aug 2026

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
notes: SLAS / Account Manager OAuth clients issuing JWTs; credentials require a B2C Commerce instance (customer or partner); Salesforce publishes the B2C DX MCP server

name: MrScraper
notes: API token; Free plan with monthly tokens, no card; official MCP server on GitHub

name: Supabase
notes: Project API keys + user JWTs for data APIs; personal access tokens or OAuth for the Management API; free plan; official Supabase MCP

name: Linear
notes: Personal API keys or OAuth2; free plan; GraphQL API; official remote MCP at mcp.linear.app

name: Xero
notes: OAuth 2.0 (custom connections use client credentials); free Starter developer tier up to 5 connections; official XeroAPI MCP server

name: YouTube Transcript
notes: API key (sk_…); 100 free credits, no card; paid plans from $5/month; official MCP at transcriptapi.com/mcp
